english.title: Person in charge of aerodrome fail to inform CAA of periods applicable equipment is in operation for providing aid
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person in charge of the aerodrome at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) for which there was equipment for providing aid for holding, let-down or an approach to landing by radio or radar, failed to

(A)_[inform the CAA in advance of the periods during and times at which any such equipment was to be in operation for the purpose of providing such aid as was specified by you]_
(B)_[during any period and at such times as were notified, cause an approach control service to be provided]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 183 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the person in charge of an aerodrome for which there was equipment for providing aid for holding, let-down or an approach to landing by radio or radar
failed to inform the CAA in advance of the periods during and times at which any such equipment was to be in operation for the purpose of providing such aid as was specified by you OR
failed to during any period and at such times as were notified, cause an approach control service to be provided

english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being the person in charge of the aerodrome at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) for which there was equipment for providing aid for holding, let-down or an approach to landing by radio or radar, failed to

(A)_[inform the CAA in advance of the periods during and times at which any such equipment was to be in operation for the purpose of providing such aid as was specified by him.]_
(B)_[inform the CAA in advance of the periods during and times at which any such equipment was to be in operation for the purpose of providing such aid as was specified by her.]_
(C)_[during any period and at such times as were notified, cause an approach control service to be provided.]_
